zh.title: 審計部指無人機防禦系統漏頻段 國防部承諾更新
zh.summary: 審計部年度決算報告指出空軍委託中科院建置的固定式無人機防禦系統未涵蓋中國5.1GHz頻段及北斗部分頻段，對光纖與AI自主無人機幾無反制，進度嚴重落後；國防部發言人孫立方表示將透過系統更新納入新頻段，並由國防創新小組尋求或自研光纖、AI反制能力。
body: 審計部公布的民國114年度中央政府總決算審核報告指出，空軍統籌委託國家中山科學研究院建置固定式「遙控無人機防禦系統」，但該系統偵測、干擾頻段未涵蓋中國近年推出5.1GHz新機型，干擾衛星導航範圍也漏掉中國北斗3號部分頻段，且對光纖式無人機、AI自主導航無人機幾無反制手段，建置進度持續落後。
國防部發言人孫立方中將表示，中國後來在112年提出的5.1GHz頻段在台灣並非合法使用頻段，但中科院會透過系統更新方式，納入偵蒐及反制無人機設備中。
至於反制光纖、AI導控無人機方式，孫立方指出這確實是新的發展，也非110年的建案中，但國防部會透過國防創新小組（DIU）尋找國外成熟商源，或透過自行研發等方式去籌獲反制系統。
立法院經濟、外交及國防、財政委員會上午第2次聯席會議，針對行政院版、國民黨及民眾黨版無人機條例草案進行逐條審查。
中科院所建置的無人機反制系統於110年建案，是針對2.4GHz、5.8GHz、1.2GHz、1.5GHz，共4個一、二類無人機頻段建置。

en.title: Audit Finds UAV Defense System Misses New Chinese Frequencies; MOD Pledges Updates
en.summary: The Audit Department's 2025 final audit report says the Air Force‑commissioned fixed UAV defense system built by NCSIST does not cover China's new 5.1 GHz band nor parts of the BeiDou‑3 navigation frequencies, and lacks countermeasures against fiber‑optic and AI‑guided drones, with deployment seriously behind schedule. The Ministry of Defense spokesperson said the 5.1 GHz band is not legal in Taiwan but NCSIST will add it via a system update, and the MOD will seek mature foreign solutions through the Defense Innovation Unit or develop domestic capabilities for fiber‑optic and AI drone threats.
body: The Audit Department's 114th‑year central government final audit report states that the Air Force tasked the National Chung‑Shan Institute of Science and Technology (NCSIST) to build a fixed “remote‑controlled UAV defense system,” but its detection and jamming bands do not cover China's recent 5.1 GHz models, miss parts of the BeiDou‑3 frequencies, and have almost no countermeasures against fiber‑optic or AI‑autonomous UAVs, with deployment progress continuing to lag.

MOD spokesperson Lieutenant General Sun Li‑fang said the 5.1 GHz band introduced by China in 2023 is not a legal band in Taiwan, but NCSIST will incorporate it into detection and counter‑UAV equipment through a system update.

Regarding fiber‑optic and AI‑guided UAV countermeasures, Sun noted this is a new development not covered in the original 2021 plan, and the MOD will pursue mature foreign sources via the Defense Innovation Unit (DIU) or develop indigenous solutions to acquire such capabilities.

The Legislative Yuan’s joint committee of the Economic, Foreign Affairs, National Defense, and Finance committees held its second meeting to conduct a clause‑by‑clause review of the Executive Yuan, KMT, and TPP draft UAV regulations.
The NCSIST‑built UAV countermeasure system was originally planned in 2021 targeting four frequency bands: 2.4 GHz, 5.8 GHz, 1.2 GHz, and 1.5 GHz.

en.title: CAA orders conservative dispatch and alternates as Typhoon Hongxia forces 22 international cancellations
en.summary: The Civil Aeronautics Administration issued a press release on 24 July 2026 stating that Typhoon Hongxia is expected to cause 22 international flight cancellations tomorrow. Airlines are ordered to operate conservatively, carry sufficient fuel, and prepare at least two alternate airports, one outside the typhoon’s impact zone. Carriers have notified passengers via SMS, email, website and app and must assist with rebooking or refunds. As of 23:00 today, 20 domestic flights were cancelled and three delayed, with two international cancellations; 22 flights at Taoyuan were diverted to Songshan, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Hong Kong and Macau due to gusts and wind shear.
body: The Civil Aeronautics Administration released a statement on 24 July 2026 saying Typhoon Hongxia will likely force 22 international flight cancellations tomorrow.
As of 23:00 today, 20 domestic flights were cancelled and three delayed, while two international flights were cancelled.
At 23:00, 22 flights at Taoyuan Airport were diverted to Songshan, Taichung, Kaohsiung, Hong Kong and Macau because of strong gusts and wind shear.
The CAA requires airlines to operate conservatively, carry sufficient fuel, and have alternate airports ready.
Airlines have notified passengers via SMS, email, website and app and must assist with rebooking or refunds according to weather conditions.

zh.title: 聯合防禦操演驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量
zh.summary: 國軍於7月13至17日舉行聯合防禦操演，知情人士稱已驗證直屬參謀本部戰略預備隊應變能量；學者蘇紫雲指出戰略預備隊為核心編制，涵蓋陸航601旅阿帕契直升機及跨域機動部隊，將在漢光實兵想定中保障核心設施安全，並預計在關鍵時刻鞏固政經核心與關鍵基礎設施安全。
body: 國軍於7月13日至17日舉行聯合防禦操演，知情人士指出此次操演已驗證直屬參謀本部的戰略預備隊應變能量。
國防部智庫國防安全研究院學者蘇紫雲接受訪問時說明，戰略預備隊是軍事作戰上的核心組織結構，指揮官通常保留一個營作為戰術活棋，並在第一線遭突破時快速反應、填補缺口。
蘇紫雲指出，戰略預備隊不受單一戰區轄制；配備AH-64E阿帕契攻擊直升機的陸航601旅部分單位即直屬參謀本部，具備高速機動、跨越水陸空界面的部隊以及空軍聯隊、部分海軍兵力均可在戰略預備隊想定中扮演重要角色。
學者推測，在漢光實兵等聯合作戰想定下，戰略預備隊已不再局限於單一陸上打擊，而是涵蓋陸海空軍戰力，屆時將於關鍵時刻鞏固並確保政經核心、關鍵基礎設施的安全。
此次操演結束後，國防部持續強化訓練力度及制度改革，以因應共軍近年持續的文攻武嚇與周邊海空域侵擾。

en.title: Joint defense exercise verifies strategic reserve under General Staff
en.summary: The ROC armed forces conducted a joint defense exercise from July 13 to 17. Informed sources said the drill verified the response capability of the strategic reserve directly subordinate to the General Staff. Scholar Su Tzu‑yun of the Institute for National Defense and Security Research explained that the strategic reserve is a core organisational element, kept as a tactical reserve for rapid reinforcement. He noted that units such as the Army Aviation 601st Brigade equipped with AH‑64E Apache helicopters, high‑speed cross‑domain forces, Air Force wings and Navy assets can all serve in the strategic reserve. Su speculated that under Han Kuang live‑force scenarios the reserve would encompass joint land, sea and air power to protect political‑economic centres and critical infrastructure at decisive moments.
body: The ROC armed forces held a joint defense exercise from July 13 to 17, and informed sources said the drill verified the response capability of the strategic reserve directly subordinate to the General Staff.

Su Tzu‑yun, a scholar at the Institute for National Defense and Security Research, explained that the strategic reserve is a core organisational element, typically retained as a tactical reserve for rapid reinforcement when front‑line units are breached.

Su noted that the strategic reserve is not confined to a single theater; the Army Aviation 601st Brigade, which operates AH‑64E Apache attack helicopters, has elements directly under the General Staff, and high‑speed cross‑domain units, Air Force wings and Navy forces can all be assigned to the reserve.

He speculated that under Han Kuang live‑force scenarios the strategic reserve would no longer be limited to land strike but would integrate land, sea and air power to secure political‑economic centres and critical infrastructure at critical moments.
The Ministry of National Defense continues to intensify training and institutional reforms to counter the PLA’s ongoing gray‑zone pressure and frequent incursions around Taiwan.

en.title: FAA Proposes $263,750 and $50,000 Fines Against Southern Airways Express for Alleged Violations
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a $263,750 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express of Addison, Texas, for allegedly operating a Cessna Caravan with a malfunctioning autopilot on 29 commercial flights in April 2025. The agency also proposed a $50,000 penalty against the carrier for allegedly violating weight-and-balance regulations that caused an incident when an airplane pushed back from the gate. Southern Airways Express has 30 days to respond to the notices.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration proposed a $263,750 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express of Addison, Texas, for allegedly operating a Cessna Caravan with a malfunctioning autopilot on 29 commercial flights in April 2025. The agency alleges the autopilot was inoperative required equipment, violating the carrier's Operations Specifications.

The FAA also proposed a $50,000 civil penalty against Southern Airways Express, LCC of Addison, Texas, for allegedly violating weight-and-balance regulations that caused an incident when an airplane pushed back from the gate. Southern Airways Express has 30 days after receiving the notices to respond.

zh.title: FAA 將於 7 月 24 日發布 5G 干擾無線電高度計最終規則
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）今日發布聲明，確認將於 2026 年 7 月 24 日頒布最終規則，強制要求在美國領空運作的飛機無線電高度計必須符合新一代性能要求，確保能夠承受鄰近頻段 5G 無線通訊訊號的干擾，以保障飛行安全。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）宣布將於 2026 年 7 月 24 日發布最終規則，針對飛機無線電高度計在鄰近頻段 5G 無線訊號干擾下的抗擾能力訂定新標準。
新規將要求所有在美國運作、裝備無線電高度計的飛機必須符合新一代性能要求，以確保高度計能承受 5G 訊號干擾並正常運作。

en.title: FAA to Issue Final Rule on 5G Interference with Radio Altimeters July 24
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on July 22 that it will issue a final rule on July 24, 2026, requiring all aircraft radio altimeters operating in the United States to meet next-generation performance requirements to ensure they can withstand interference from 5G wireless signals in neighboring spectrum bands. The rule aims to address longstanding concerns about potential interference between 5G networks and aircraft altimeters, which are critical for low-visibility landings and terrain awareness.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced it will issue a final rule on July 24, 2026, addressing aircraft radio altimeter performance in the presence of 5G wireless signals in adjacent spectrum bands.
The rule will require all radio altimeters equipped on aircraft operating in the United States to meet next-generation performance standards to ensure they can withstand interference from 5G signals.

en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has proposed a $306,000 civil penalty against Simulator Center LLC, a pilot training center based in Sanford, Florida. According to the Federal Aviation Administration, the civil penalty is being proposed due to alleged training violations. Specifically, the regulator alleged that Simulator Center LLC allowed unqualified instructors to provide flight training and failed to ensure that several students completed required flight training before concluding their instruction.
